S21.name: 巨型等足虫
S21.form: a broad flattened body, a shield-like segmented carapace, seven pairs of legs, large compound eyes, two pairs of antennae, a fan-shaped tail

S22.name: 管虫
S22.form: a smooth cylindrical body, a funnel-shaped feathery gill crown at the front end, a head modified into a tentacle crown, the body attached to rock or sand, no mouth and no digestive system
S22.colour: 肉头部分呈红色，栖管呈白色

S23.name: 深海虾虎
S23.form: an elongated slender body, a large head, a blunt snout, large eyes, a terminal mouth, ctenoid scales
S23.fins: two dorsal fins, the pelvic fins joined into a disc under the throat, a rounded tail fin

S25.name: 鮟鱇鱼
S25.form: a large broad depressed head, a huge mouth, backward-curved teeth, loose scaleless skin, a fishing lure on the head, gill openings behind the pectoral-fin base, a stout body tapering to the tail
S25.fins: a dorsal fin with the front rays forming a lure, small pectoral fins, pelvic fins set forward under the throat

S26.name: 角鮟鱇
S26.form: a rounded globose body, a large head, a huge mouth with long sharp teeth, a fishing lure on the snout, loose scaleless skin, small eyes
S26.fins: small pectoral fins, a small dorsal fin, pelvic fins set under the throat

S27.name: 树须鱼
S27.form: a short body, smooth skin, many barbels on the lower jaw branching like tree roots, a short illicium set behind the tip of the snout, a nearly horizontal mouth cleft, no second dorsal spine, no fleshy flap on the back, 4 to 5 branchiostegal rays
S27.fins: a dorsal fin with 3 rays, an anal fin with 2 to 4 rays

S28.name: 深海章鱼
S28.form: a rounded bag-like body, eight arms, a large head, large eyes, no internal shell

S29.name: 吸血乌贼
S29.form: a small gelatinous body, eight arms joined by a webbed cloak-like membrane, a pair of small fins on top of the body, large eyes, rows of fleshy spines on the arms
S29.fins: a pair of small rounded fins on the upper body

S30.name: 幽灵蛸
S30.form: a small gelatinous body, a webbed cloak-like membrane connecting all the arms, dozens of fleshy projections on the arms, large eyes
